{{Quote|I am Russo-ISC, crime scene analyzer for the Jedi. I will be working with you and your Padawan on this case. I was assigned by Master Windu.|Russo-ISC introducing himself Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
'''Russo-ISC''' was a [[Forensics droid/Legends|crime scene analysis droid]] who worked on behalf of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he was assigned by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to investigate the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple]]. Russo met [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were also assigned the mission, in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Despite rumors that a [[Jedi]] was involved in the plot, Skywalker convinced Russo to bring Tano with him as he interviewed the witnesses. Inside the [[Halls of Healing]], Russo and Tano interviewed the witnesses and learned [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]] was their suspected [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]]. 

When Russo checked the Temple's security footage, he discovered Bowmani was fed [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]] which went into the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin's]] [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]] and transformed Bowmani into a walking [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]], leaving only his [[Limb/Legends|hand]] unharmed. After Bowmani's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] was arrested by Skywalker and Tano for feeding her husband the [[Droid/Legends|nano-droids]], Russo rechecked the security footage, confirming that Bowmani carried out the bombing on his own. Therefore, based off his analysis, Russo concluded that no Jedi aided the Abyssin.

==Biography==
===Work on Coruscant===
Russo-ISC was a [[Forensics droid/Legends|crime scene analysis droid]] who worked for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> He was constructed<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]<ref name="FF55" /> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Coruscant SWE">{{SWE|locations|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Analysis droid/Legends|analysis droid]] was stationed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where he aided [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]] and [[Jedi Peacekeeper|Peacekeepers]], since the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] role as [[Jedi investigator/Legends|investigators]] in the modern Jedi Order had extended to crime-prevention and [[Detective/Legends|detective]] work.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Temple_Sacrifice.png|thumb|left|275px|Russo and his team of analysis droids assisted the Jedi in crime scene analysis inside Coruscant's Jedi Temple.]]
Analysis [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as Russo became more prevalent as the pall of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] clouded Jedi investigators' ability to use their connection and intuition to the Force. The Jedi's reliance on Russo and the other analysis droids continued during the Clone Wars, resulting in the Jedi's services became overshadowed by their new responsibilities as military [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]; a role that never felt comfortable to the Jedi. Therefore, Russo and his team assisted the Jedi in crime scene analysis.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

While the Jedi became more reliant on the technological resources available to them in the Jedi Temple, Russo and his team of analysis droids worked alongside the investigators, assisting the Jedi in crime scene analysis and helping them solve mysteries. Resources available to Russo's team included the Temple's cutting-edge analysis facilities and equipment, which helped his team and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] during their investigations. Jedi detectives such as Russo could also access the extensive stock of research material available to them in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], which was cared for by [[Jedi librarian/Legends|Jedi librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===Meeting Tano and Skywalker===
{{Quote|Only analysis and investigation will prove what is true or not.|Russo-ISC to Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:AhsokaandAnakinintheTemplehangar-Sabotage.png|thumb|right|300px|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker aided Russo in the investigation of the Temple bombing.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Fact File 42">{{FactFile2014|42|20 BBY 51-54|Jedi Temple bombing}}</ref> an [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|explosion]] destroyed many [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|gunships]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] many Jedi, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]], and civilians alike in one of the Temple's [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]].<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> The shocking act of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]] against the Jedi Temple proved how fragile the image of the Jedi as the Republic's benevolent protectors of had become.<ref name="NoLive Sabotage Ep Guide" /> The [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]] sparked [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|near-continuous protests]] outside the Jedi Temple which became a daily reminder that the peoples' trust the Jedi had enjoyed for years had been used up.<ref name="Fact File 42" /> As a result, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] tasked Russo with analyzing the damage and to question any witnesses. In the Temple hangar bay, Russo consulted with Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on the results of his investigation.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> Tano and Skywalker tried to use the Force to detect strong emotions and impressions. However, the emotional shock of the bombing was so intense that it blotted everything else out.<ref name="TCW Ep Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Therefore, Tano and Skywalker relied on Russo and his team's assistance while they investigated the bombing.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

Despite the rising fear and paranoia, especially with the Jedi, Russo, Skywalker and Tano began looking for clues to the culprit's identity.<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> Skywalker requested that Russo and Tano began the interviews of the witnesses together. Russo countered, requesting to interview the witnesses<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> and survivors<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> by himself as many of the wounded heard rumors a Jedi was responsible for the bombing and would therefore be ill will towards Tano,<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> since they believed a rogue Jedi may have been responsible for the bombing.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Skywalker disagreed and requested Russo bring Tano with him as the bombing caused the deaths of many Jedi, in addition to Temple maintenance workers and clone troopers.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

===Witness interviews===
{{Quote|I believe it was Jackar Bowmani.''"<br />"'' ''[&hellip;]'' Who is Jackar?''"<br />"''One of the maintenance crew in the hangar. ''[&hellip;]'' I passed him as I was going on my shift change. He... he had been working all morning in the section the blast came from. It was the last place I saw him.|A Pantoran witness informed Russo and Tano on the identity of his presumed suspect|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:AhsokaRussoPantoran-Sabotage.png|thumb|left|300px|Russo showed a holographic image of Bowmani to the Pantoran witness.]]
While they were in the [[Halls of Healing]], Tano informed Russo the distrust of the witnesses was troubling, especially since many of them had worked in the Jedi Temple for years. Russo reminded her that even the most trusting individuals became irrational when they were afraid. After their conversation concluded, [[Unidentified_Pantoran_witness/Legends|one injured witness]] said he believed that [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]], an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|maintenance crew member]], was the hangar bombing culprit. While Russo looked up Bowmani on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], Tano asked the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] to inform them on Bowmani's identity. The witness informed them that he had passed Bowmani as he began his shift. The Abyssin had worked all [[Standard day/Legends|morning]] in the section of the hangar the blast came from, and he had not seen Bowmani since the explosion. After the witness confirmed that the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic image]] of an Abyssin shown on Russo's datapad was of Bowmani, Russo asked the Pantoran witness if he had seen Bowmani since the bomb detonated. The Pantoran replied he had not seen Bowmani or anything else after the explosion.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

As Russo and Tano prepared to depart the Hall of Healing, Tano told Russo their next mission was to find Bowmani. At the doors, they conversed with Skywalker, who informed them the rumor the perpetrator was a Jedi was continued to grow. Skywalker told them he sensed increased confusion and anger throughout the Temple. In response, Tano told Skywalker she and Russo had a lead. She told Skywalker they were looking for Bowmani, as she showed Skywalker the holographic information of Bowmani on an [[Imagecaster/Legends|imagecaster]]. Russo informed Skywalker one of the witnesses saw Bowmani in the hangar before the bomb exploded and Bowmani had been unaccounted for since the explosion. Skywalker responded that no one just disappears and Russo replied the bombing must have therefore been well planned out. Skywalker angrily told Russo and Tano a well-planned out attack was the only explanation for Jedi being unable to detect the bombing. While Tano and Russo continued their investigation, Skywalker left the Halls of Healing to talk with<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]]<ref name="DatabankCin">{{SWE|characters|cin-drallig|Cin Drallig}}</ref> [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]].<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

===A shocking revelation===
{{Quote|These pieces come from the blast origin. They are covered with microscopic droids of a highly volatile nature.''"<br />"''Nano-droids.|Russo-ISC conversing with Anakin Skywalker upon finding the nano-droids|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:AnakinAhsokaRussoHangar-Sabotage.png|thumb|right|300px|Russo revealed his discovery of the nano-droids to Skywalker and Tano.]]
Through painstaking work,<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> Tano,<ref name="Fact File 42" /> Russo and his analysis droids reconstructed the trajectory and original position of each piece of bomb debris.<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> They completed the process by using advanced holographic displays that used the data they had uncovered.<ref name="Fact File 42" /> Russo and Tano then scanned the holographic crime scene reconstructions of the explosion and studied the remains of the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] and other debris. Tano used the trajectory of the debris to conclude the blast's precise origin-point. In response, Russo questioned why the hologram showed no bomb residue.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

After Skywalker arrived, Tano informed her master that she and Russo were under the assumption whoever blew up the hangar triggered a [[Gunship/Legends|ship]] to explode. While Russo used the shrapnel to see if it could help identify the perpetrator, Tano speculated that based off the Pantoran witness's first-hand account, Bowmani could have quietly planned the hangar bombing on his own. Russo then informed Skywalker and Tano that he discovered an anomaly in the holographic recording that should not have been there. Moving the holographic display around, Russo revealed pieces of debris from the origin of the blast. The debris contained [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]], which where<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> explosive military-grade<ref name="Fact File 42" /> microscopic droids of a highly volatile nature. After Russo revealed the nano-droids, Skywalker instructed Russo to analyze the security footage and see if Bowmani went anywhere else in the Temple.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

===Bowmani's background revealed===
{{Quote|The connection we were looking for to the explosion in the hangar.''"<br />"''The nano-droids. How did they get in his bloodstream?|Russo and Tano while they scanned Bowmani's remaining hand for nano-droids|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:JediTempleCentralSecurityStation-Sabotage.png|thumb|left|300px|Russo surprised Skywalker and Tano when he revealed he could scan hundreds of hours of Jedi Temple hangar security footage at a fast pace.]]
In the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|Jedi Temple security station]], an [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|analysis droid]] gave Skywalker a datapad, that displayed the file on Bowmani. The file revealed that Bowmani specialized in [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nano-weaponry]] and he was the foreman of all the Temple's gunships, [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and bombs. On the other side of the room, Tano and Skywalker met Russo, who was rapidly scanning the security monitors. Skywalker questioned the droid if the security monitors were going too fast for him to process. Russo replied it was simple data for him and at that pace, he was capable of viewing hundreds of [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of footage. When Skywalker asked Russo if he found Bowmani, the droid to lifted up<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> his visor<ref name="NoLive Sabotage Ep Guide" /> and informed the Jedi he had not. As a result, Skywalker told Russo he would gather some Jedi to search the Temple, adding if Bowmani was still in the Temple, he may have another attack planned. Gesturing to the other SP-4 analysis droids, Russo replied that his team of droids could complete the task far quicker than any Jedi. As Tano and Skywalker left the security station, Russo turned to the other droids and gave them their next task.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

[[File:Jackar-hand.png|thumb|right|300px|Bowmani's hand was the only part of his body to survive the explosion.]]
Later, Russo reported to Skywalker on a hologram that he had found Bowmani. Skywalker and Tano had just finished their latest report to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and Skywalker instructed Russo to lock down all exits to prevent Bowmani from escaping. When Skywalker and Tano arrived at Russo's location, they scanned the room, confused on why they could not find Bowmani. When Skywalker asked Russo where Bowmani was, the droid replied part of him was in the room, which caused Skywalker to quickly retort it was a bad [[Time/Legends|time]] for jokes. Russo led Tano and Skywalker to a table where he revealed to them that only Bowmani's [[Limb/Legends|hand]] remained. The rest of Bowmani's body had exploded as he physically was the bomb. Russo passed Tano a handheld [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], which confirmed that Bowmani's hand was covered in numerous nano-droids.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

After Tano asked how the droids got in Bowmani's bloodstream, Skywalker told Russo and Tano they had to search [[Jackar Bowmani's apartment/Legends|Bowmani's home]] for evidence. While Skywalker and Tano searched Bowmani's home, Tano discovered traces of nano-droids in the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] disposal, confirmation Bowmani had consumed the droids. Soon after, Bowmani's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] arrived at her home. Skywalker told Turmond they needed her to come with them to answer questions. However, Turmond fled down an alleyway, before she was cornered by the Jedi and was pressured by Skywalker to confess that she fed the nano-droids to her husband.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|I am pleased to report there were no other nano-droids found in the sweep of the Temple. I am also pleased to report based on security footage, Jackar Bowmani acted alone, meaning no Jedi were involved.|Russo-ISC reported his final conclusions to the Jedi|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:TheRussoReport-Sabotage.png|thumb|left|300px|Russo reported his final conclusions to Tano and the Jedi.]]
After Turmond was arrested, Tano and Skywalker reported to Windu and<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]<ref name="Grand Master">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main plot of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. In a ''Yoda: Dark Rendezvous'' flashback, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was referred to as the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as he spoke with a young [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], sixty-three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the novel's main plot, which equates to [[82 BBY/Legends|82 BBY]]. As ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 42]]'' dates the events of ''[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], in between those two [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|years]], Yoda was therefore the Grand Master of the Jedi Order during the events of ''Sabotage''.</ref> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] that Turmond was being held in [[Prison/Legends|cell]] in the [[Jedi Temple detention center]] while she waited for interrogation. When Russo contacted Tano on an imagecaster, he reported no other nano-droids were found in his search of the Jedi Temple. He added that based off the security footage, Bowmani had acted alone, which meant no Jedi was involved in the bombing. Tano thanked and congratulated Russo for his aid in the crime scene analysis.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

Once Russo ended the transmission, Windu told Skywalker and Tano that despite the hangar bombing having no indication of Jedi involvement, he was worried the event would fuel anti-Jedi sentiment amongst Coruscant's citizens.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> Turmond was later put under military custody and imprisoned at the [[Republic military base]], where she confessed to Tano that a Jedi had persuaded her to feed her husband the nano-droids. However, Turmond was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|strangled]] to death before she could reveal the culprit's identity to Tano.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> In the end, Skywalker proved that Tano's close friend [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was the Jedi behind the bombing of the Temple hangar.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref> Offee had directed Turmond to feed the nano-droids to Bowmani, and she later framed Tano for the bombing and the Turmond's death.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />

==Characteristics==
===Personality and traits===
{{Quote|Instead of Jedi, I have droids that can do the job much faster.|Russo to his Jedi assistants as he gestured to his subordinates|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:RussoISC_Databank.png|thumb|right|250px|Russo had a habit of flipping his visor.]]
Russo-ISC was a crime scene analysis droid,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|sensors]], as well as [[Metal/Legends|metal]] plating that was predominately blue and silver, with golden plating on his limbs and head. The [[Jedi crest/Legends|emblem]] of the Jedi Order was displayed on the left side of his chest plate.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> A no-nonsense analysis droid,<ref name="NoLive Sabotage Ep Guide" /> Russo served as a team leader, taking command over the other analysis droids that were plugged into the Jedi Temple's sensor and security networks. Russo's detectable sense of pride, strong independent streak and keen perception enabled him to take on some of the hardest cases the Jedi faced.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Despite being efficient in his analysis, his personality was at the least quirky.<ref name="Fact File 42" /> Russo punctuated his speech while he habitually flipped his visor<ref name="Sabotage trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep517|text="Sabotage" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Trivia Gallery: slide 4}}</ref> up and down as he said brusque and over-dramatic revelatory statements.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

===Skills and abilities===
{{Quote|I am Russo-ISC, crime scene analyzer for the Jedi.|Russo to Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
[[File:RussoPepTalk-Sabotage.png|thumb|left|300px|Russo spoke with his team of ISC units]]
Russo was a reliable assistant to Jedi investigators as they worked together to solve mysteries at crime scenes.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> As an ISC unit, Russo was capable of conducting in-depth questioning of witnesses and suspects. He relayed his findings to the appropriate judicial authorities, which ensured no jurisdictional issues.<ref name="FF55"/> As a result, Russo wanted to interview witnesses of the Temple bombing by himself. However, he was persuaded by Anakin Skywalker to bring his Padawan Ahsoka Tano with him to interrogate witnesses in the Halls of Healing. The visored detective and crime scene investigator led other SP-4 analysis droids as they worked with Tano and Skywalker to solve the hangar bombing case.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> Russo also could tap into the Temple's security systems, and review the holographic security footage far faster than any Jedi could review them<ref name="NoLive Sabotage Ep Guide" /> and as a result, used the security footage to conclude that Jackar Bowmani had acted alone in the bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|At this pace, I am able to view hundreds of hours of footage.|Russo was capable pf scanning fast paced security footage with his visor down|<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />}}
Russo wore a visor which he could flip up and down. He also carried a datapad and used handheld sensors to help him analyze information uncovered at the crime scene.<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Russo-ISC_illustration.png|thumb|right|200px|Russo-ISC concept art illustration by David Le Merrer.]]
Russo-ISC first appeared in "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]],"<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which premiered on [[February 9]], [[2013]].<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]],<ref name="Sabotage (episode)" /> who also voiced all the clone troopers in the series.<ref name="DBB CtQK">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091120.html|text=Dee Bradley Baker: From Clones to Queen Karina}}</ref> Russo's name, speech pattern and habit of flipping his visor to punctuate his speech all allude to [[Wikipedia:David Caruso|David Caruso's]] character [[Wikipedia:Horatio Caine|Horatio Caine]] from [[Wikipedia:CSI: Miami|''CSI: Miami'']].<ref name="Sabotage trivia gallery" /> A character illustration of Russo was drawn by [[David Le Merrer]] and posted in the Concept Art Gallery for "Sabotage."<ref name="Concept Art">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep517|text="Sabotage" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Concept Art Gallery: slide 6}}</ref>
